title: My job at the café
instructions: Öğrenci Max kafedeki yarı zamanlı işini anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; günleri, saatleri ve görevleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: max
script.text: I'm a student, and I have a job in a café near my university.

script.speaker: max
script.text: I work on Tuesdays and Thursdays from five to nine, and on Saturdays from ten to four.

script.speaker: max
script.text: I make coffee, clean the tables and wash the cups.

script.speaker: max
script.text: I don't cook. The chef, Rosa, makes all the food.

script.speaker: max
script.text: My favourite part is talking to the customers. Many of them come every day.

script.speaker: max
script.text: The worst part is Saturday. It's very busy, and I'm always tired after work.

script.speaker: max
script.text: I get ten pounds an hour. I want to save money for a holiday in Greece next summer.
